head.text: Move From Twilio to RCS Without Losing Your Numbers

attrs.content: You can port long codes, toll-free numbers and short codes off Twilio to any RCS provider. The catch: 10DLC campaigns and your verified RCS agent must be re-filed. Steps, timelines, fees, and who does the work.
